definitions.bangalore_companies: Companies with a documented professional or job connection; not a count of proven Bengaluru Pega teams.
definitions.hiring: A page-observed employer requisition explicitly confirmed available; closed/history/move/index-only records do not qualify.
definitions.hiring_lead: A recruiting or job lead without an explicit closed/historical/move status; may require current confirmation.
definitions.people_records: Deduplicated public-profile identities or name/employer/source identities; all distinct observations retained.

limitations: Public discovery is bounded, not every employee or vacancy on LinkedIn.
A checked date records evidence examination, not certainty of current employment.
A local person, event attendee or role does not establish a complete local Pega team.
Projects may be global; local project allocation needs separate evidence.
Employee moves and open-to-work posts never establish replacement vacancies.
No headcount, retention rate or salary budget is inferred from profile counts.
Page and search-index access remain attached to individual and field-specific sources.
